name: Kujou Shinobu
source: Attends Ootori Academy’s rival, Suzaku Academy. He’s the star performer in the Suzaku theatre troupe and a friend of Kei’s. He is also the heir to his family’s zaibatsu corporation, Kujou Group. Due to his wealthy upbringing and being raised to believe we was the best at everything, he’s very lax so he tends to spoil himself and others.
translation: Attends Ootori Academy’s rival, Suzaku Academy. He’s the star performer in the Suzaku theatre troupe and a friend of Kei’s. He is also the heir to his family’s zaibatsu corporation, Kujou Group. Due to his wealthy upbringing and being raised to believe we was the best at everything, he’s very lax so he tends to spoil himself and others.
